description: This file defines models, classes, and interfaces for dashboard components and widgets in the Thingsboard UI, including widget layout management, highlighting, selection, and configuration.

classes.name: DashboardWidgets
classes.description: Manages a collection of dashboard widgets, handling addition, removal, updates, highlighting, selection, and sorting.

classes.name: DashboardWidget
classes.description: Represents an individual widget within the dashboard, including layout, styling, highlighting, selection, and aspect ratio preservation.

methods.name: doCheck
methods.description: Detects changes in widgets and widget layouts, updating the dashboard widget collection accordingly.

methods.name: widgetLayoutsUpdated
methods.description: Updates widget layouts and recalculates layout parameters.

methods.name: setWidgets
methods.description: Sets the current widgets and their layouts.

methods.name: highlightWidget
methods.description: Highlights a widget by ID, managing highlight mode and visual state.

methods.name: selectWidget
methods.description: Selects a widget by ID, updating selection state.

methods.name: resetHighlight
methods.description: Resets all widget highlights and selections.

methods.name: isHighlighted
methods.description: Checks if a widget is highlighted.

methods.name: isNotHighlighted
methods.description: Checks if a widget is not highlighted.

methods.name: getSelectedWidget
methods.description: Returns the currently selected widget.

methods.name: updateRowsAndSort
methods.description: Recalculates maximum rows and sorts widgets based on order.

methods.name: sortWidgets
methods.description: Sorts widgets by their layout order and position.

methods.name: updateWidgetParams
methods.description: Updates widget visual parameters and state based on configuration.

methods.name: updateParamsFromData
methods.description: Updates widget parameters based on data and configuration.

methods.name: updateCustomHeaderActions
methods.description: Filters and updates custom header actions for a widget.

methods.name: filterCustomHeaderAction
methods.description: Determines if a custom header action should be shown based on data.

methods.name: gridsterItemComponent$
methods.description: Returns an observable of the gridster item component.

methods.name: updateWidgetParams
methods.description: Updates visual parameters of a widget, including title, style, and actions.

methods.name: updateParamsFromData
methods.description: Refreshes widget label patterns and header actions.

methods.name: applyPreserveAspectRatio
methods.description: Adjusts widget size and aspect ratio preservation logic.

methods.name: updatePosition
methods.description: Updates widget position in the grid layout.
